NAME
       lldp-neighbors - show lldp neighbors information.

MODULE
       net

SYNTAX
       show lldp-neighbors information within the net module using the syntax shown in the following sections.

   DISPLAY
	show lldp-neighbors
	  options:
	    all
	    all-properties

DESCRIPTION
       show lldp neighbor information.

SEE ALSO
       modify, show, tmsh
